extracted.intended_audience: attorneys/applicants seeking reinstatement to practice before the USPTO; counsel and Office of Enrollment and Discipline staff
extracted.subtask_description: Administrative decision on a petition for reinstatement to practice before the United States Patent and Trademark Office, considering a petition and an affidavit filed under 37 CFR § 11.58 and decided by the Director of the Office of Enrollment and Discipline.

rubrics_metrics.name: Affidavit pursuant to 37 CFR § 11.58
rubrics_metrics.description: Mr. Blackowicz, through counsel, has filed an Affidavit pursuant to 37 CFR § 11.58 in support of the Petition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A petition for reinstatement should be supported by an affidavit filed under 37 CFR § 11.58. (This document references that such an affidavit was filed but does not state the affidavit's required contents.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Director's review and discretionary determination
rubrics_metrics.description: After careful review of the Petition, and the supporting affidavit, the Director of the Office of Enrollment and Discipline has determined that reinstatement of Mr. Blackowicz to practice before the United States Patent and Trademark Office is appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Director reviews the petition and supporting affidavit and has discretion to determine whether reinstatement is appropriate; if so, the Director issues an order granting reinstatement ('Petition is hereby GRANTED').

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing/receipt and service of decision
rubrics_metrics.description: Consideration has been given to the Petition for Reinstatement of Jeremy U. Blackowicz received on June 25, 2015. Copy to: Mr. Steven A. Fredley, Harris, Wiltshire & Grannis, LLP.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Petitions must be filed/received by the Office of Enrollment and Discipline (date of receipt is noted). The decision is documented and copies are provided to counsel or other listed recipients.
